implications.group_reason: composes statements of one challenge file, ComparatorChallenges.CompleteCrossing
implications.statement:
∀ {Vertex Edge : Type} {graph : OAI.Paper170.Graph Vertex Edge} (self : OAI.Paper170.AdmissibleDrawing graph)
  (edge other : Edge),
  edge ≠ other →
    ∀ point ∈ OAI.Paper170.edgeInterior self.toContinuousDrawing edge,
      point ∈ OAI.Paper170.edgeInterior self.toContinuousDrawing other →
        ∃ chart,
          point ∈ chart.source ∧
            ↑chart point = (0, 0) ∧
              ↑chart '' (chart.source ∩ OAI.Paper170.edgeInterior self.toContinuousDrawing edge) =
                  chart.target ∩ {image | image.2 = 0} ∧
                ↑chart '' (chart.source ∩ OAI.Paper170.edgeInterior self.toContinuousDrawing other) =
                  chart.target ∩ {image | image.1 = 0}
